<html:html xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"><html:body><html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                        <html:col width="4%" />
                        <html:col width="4%" />
                        <html:col width="92%" />
                        <html:tbody>
                           <html:tr>
                              <html:td valign="top" />
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:p class="oj-normal">1C351</html:p>
                              </html:td>
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:span>Human and animal pathogens and "toxins", as follows:</html:span>
                                 <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                    <html:col width="4%" />
                                    <html:col width="96%" />
                                    <html:tbody>
                                       <html:tr>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:p class="oj-normal">a.</html:p>
                                          </html:td>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:p class="oj-normal">Viruses, whether natural, enhanced or modified, either in the form of "isolated live cultures" or as material including living material which has been deliberately inoculated or contaminated with such cultures, as follows:</html:p>
                                             <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                <html:col width="4%" />
                                                <html:col width="96%" />
                                                <html:tbody>
                                                   <html:tr>
                                                      <html:td valign="top">
                                                         <html:p class="oj-normal">1.</html:p>
                                                      </html:td>
                                                      <html:td valign="top">
                                                         <html:p class="oj-normal">African horse sickness virus;</html:p>
                                                      </html:td>
                                                   </html:tr>
                                                </html:tbody>
                                             </html:table>
                                             <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                <html:col width="4%" />
                                                <html:col width="96%" />
                                                <html:tbody>
                                                   <html:tr>
                                                      <html:td valign="top">
                                                         <html:p class="oj-normal">2.</html:p>
                                                      </html:td>
                                                      <html:td valign="top">
                                                         <html:p class="oj-normal">African swine fever virus;</html:p>
                                                      </html:td>
                                                   </html:tr>
                                                </html:tbody>
                                             </html:table>
                                             </html:td>
                                       </html:tr>
                                    </html:tbody>
                                 </html:table>
                                 <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                    <html:col width="4%" />
                                    <html:col width="96%" />
                                    <html:tbody>
                                       <html:tr>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:p class="oj-normal">b.</html:p>
                                          </html:td>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:p class="oj-normal">Not used;</html:p>
                                          </html:td>
                                       </html:tr>
                                    </html:tbody>
                                 </html:table>
                                 <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                    <html:col width="8%" />
                                    <html:col width="92%" />
                                    <html:tbody>
                                       <html:tr>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:p class="normal">
                                                <html:span class="oj-underline">
                                                   <html:span class="oj-italic">Note:</html:span>
                                                </html:span>
                                             </html:p>
                                          </html:td>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:span>
                                                <html:span class="oj-italic">1C351 does not control "vaccines" or "immunotoxins".</html:span>
                                             </html:span>
                                          </html:td>
                                       </html:tr>
                                    </html:tbody>
                                 </html:table>
                              </html:td>
                           </html:tr>
                        </html:tbody>
                     </html:table>
                     <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                        <html:col width="4%" />
                        <html:col width="4%" />
                        <html:col width="92%" />
                        <html:tbody>
                           <html:tr>
                              <html:td valign="top" />
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:p class="oj-normal">1C353</html:p>
                              </html:td>
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:span>'Genetic elements' and 'genetically-modified organisms', as follows:</html:span>
                                 <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                    <html:col width="4%" />
                                    <html:col width="96%" />
                                    <html:tbody>
                                       <html:tr>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:p class="oj-normal">a.</html:p>
                                          </html:td>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:p class="oj-normal">Any 'genetically-modified organism' which contains, or 'genetic element' that codes for, any of the following:</html:p>
                                             <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                <html:col width="4%" />
                                                <html:col width="96%" />
                                                <html:tbody>
                                                   <html:tr>
                                                      <html:td valign="top">
                                                         <html:p class="oj-normal">1.</html:p>
                                                      </html:td>
                                                      <html:td valign="top">
                                                         <html:p class="oj-normal">Any gene, genes, translated product or translated products, specific to any virus specified in 1C351.a. or 1C354.a.;</html:p>
                                                      </html:td>
                                                   </html:tr>
                                                </html:tbody>
                                             </html:table>
                                             <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                <html:col width="4%" />
                                                <html:col width="96%" />
                                                <html:tbody>
                                                   <html:tr>
                                                      <html:td valign="top">
                                                         <html:p class="oj-normal">2.</html:p>
                                                      </html:td>
                                                      <html:td valign="top">
                                                         <html:p class="oj-normal">Any gene or genes specific to any bacterium specified in 1C351.c. or 1C354.b. or fungus specified in 1C351.e. or 1C354.c., and which is any of the following:</html:p>
                                                         <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                            <html:col width="4%" />
                                                            <html:col width="96%" />
                                                            <html:tbody>
                                                               <html:tr>
                                                                  <html:td valign="top">
                                                                     <html:p class="oj-normal">a.</html:p>
                                                                  </html:td>
                                                                  <html:td valign="top">
                                                                     <html:p class="oj-normal">In itself or through its transcribed or translated products represents a significant hazard to human, animal or plant health; <html:span class="oj-underline">or</html:span>
                                                                     </html:p>
                                                                  </html:td>
                                                               </html:tr>
                                                            </html:tbody>
                                                         </html:table>
                                                         <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                            <html:col width="4%" />
                                                            <html:col width="96%" />
                                                            <html:tbody>
                                                               <html:tr>
                                                                  <html:td valign="top">
                                                                     <html:p class="oj-normal">b.</html:p>
                                                                  </html:td>
                                                                  <html:td valign="top">
                                                                     <html:p class="oj-normal">Could 'endow or enhance pathogenicity'; <html:span class="oj-underline">or</html:span>
                                                                     </html:p>
                                                                  </html:td>
                                                               </html:tr>
                                                            </html:tbody>
                                                         </html:table>
                                                      </html:td>
                                                   </html:tr>
                                                </html:tbody>
                                             </html:table>
                                             </html:td>
                                       </html:tr>
                                    </html:tbody>
                                 </html:table>
                                 <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                    <html:col width="4%" />
                                    <html:col width="96%" />
                                    <html:tbody>
                                       <html:tr>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:p class="oj-normal">b.</html:p>
                                          </html:td>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:p class="oj-normal">Not used.</html:p>
                                          </html:td>
                                       </html:tr>
                                    </html:tbody>
                                 </html:table>
                                 <html:p class="oj-ti-annotation" id="d1e14456-3-1">
                                    <html:span class="oj-italic">
                                       <html:span class="oj-underline">Technical Notes:</html:span>
                                    </html:span>
                                 </html:p>
                                 <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                    <html:col width="8%" />
                                    <html:col width="92%" />
                                    <html:tbody>
                                       <html:tr>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:p class="normal">
                                                <html:span class="oj-underline">
                                                   <html:span class="oj-italic">Note 1:</html:span>
                                                </html:span>
                                             </html:p>
                                          </html:td>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:span>
                                                <html:span class="oj-italic">1C353 does not control nucleic acid sequences of shiga toxin producing Escherichia coli of serogroups O26, O45, O103, O104, O111, O121, O145, O157, and other shiga toxin producing serogroups, other than those genetic elements coding for shiga toxin, or for its subunits.</html:span>
                                             </html:span>
                                          </html:td>
                                       </html:tr>
                                    </html:tbody>
                                 </html:table>
                                 <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                    <html:col width="8%" />
                                    <html:col width="92%" />
                                    <html:tbody>
                                       <html:tr>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:p class="normal">
                                                <html:span class="oj-underline">
                                                   <html:span class="oj-italic">Note 2:</html:span>
                                                </html:span>
                                             </html:p>
                                          </html:td>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:span>
                                                <html:span class="oj-italic">1C353 does not control "vaccines".</html:span>
                                             </html:span>
                                          </html:td>
                                       </html:tr>
                                    </html:tbody>
                                 </html:table>
                              </html:td>
                           </html:tr>
                        </html:tbody>
                     </html:table>
                     <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                        <html:col width="4%" />
                        <html:col width="4%" />
                        <html:col width="92%" />
                        <html:tbody>
                           <html:tr>
                              <html:td valign="top" />
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:p class="oj-normal">1C354</html:p>
                              </html:td>
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:span>Plant pathogens, as follows:</html:span>
                                 <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                    <html:col width="4%" />
                                    <html:col width="96%" />
                                    <html:tbody>
                                       <html:tr>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:p class="oj-normal">a.</html:p>
                                          </html:td>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:p class="oj-normal">Viruses, whether natural, enhanced or modified, either in the form of "isolated live cultures" or as material including living material which has been deliberately inoculated or contaminated with such cultures, as follows:</html:p>
                                             <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                <html:col width="4%" />
                                                <html:col width="96%" />
                                                <html:tbody>
                                                   <html:tr>
                                                      <html:td valign="top">
                                                         <html:p class="oj-normal">1.</html:p>
                                                      </html:td>
                                                      <html:td valign="top">
                                                         <html:p class="oj-normal">Andean potato latent virus (Potato Andean latent tymovirus);</html:p>
                                                      </html:td>
                                                   </html:tr>
                                                </html:tbody>
                                             </html:table>
                                             <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                <html:col width="4%" />
                                                <html:col width="96%" />
                                                <html:tbody>
                                                   <html:tr>
                                                      <html:td valign="top">
                                                         <html:p class="oj-normal">2.</html:p>
                                                      </html:td>
                                                      <html:td valign="top">
                                                         <html:p class="oj-normal">Potato spindle tuber viroid;</html:p>
                                                      </html:td>
                                                   </html:tr>
                                                </html:tbody>
                                             </html:table>
                                          </html:td>
                                       </html:tr>
                                    </html:tbody>
                                 </html:table>
                                 <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                    <html:col width="4%" />
                                    <html:col width="96%" />
                                    <html:tbody>
                                       <html:tr>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:p class="oj-normal">b.</html:p>
                                          </html:td>
                                          <html:td valign="top">
                                             <html:p class="oj-normal">Bacteria, whether natural, enhanced or modified, either in the form of "isolated live cultures" or as material which has been deliberately inoculated or contaminated with such cultures, as follows:</html:p>
                                             <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                <html:col width="4%" />
                                                <html:col width="96%" />
                                                <html:tbody>
                                                   <html:tr>
                                                      <html:td valign="top">
                                                         <html:p class="oj-normal">1.</html:p>
                                                      </html:td>
                                                      <html:td valign="top">
                                                         <html:p class="oj-normal">Xanthomonas albilineans;</html:p>
                                                      </html:td>
                                                   </html:tr>
                                                </html:tbody>
                                             </html:table>
                                             <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                <html:col width="4%" />
                                                <html:col width="96%" />
                                                <html:tbody>
                                                   <html:tr>
                                                      <html:td valign="top">
                                                         <html:p class="oj-normal">2.</html:p>
                                                      </html:td>
                                                      <html:td valign="top">
                                                         <html:p class="oj-normal">Xanthomonas citri pv. citri (Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. citri, Xanthomonas campestris pv. citri);</html:p>
                                                      </html:td>
                                                   </html:tr>
                                                </html:tbody>
                                             </html:table>
                                             </html:td>
                                       </html:tr>
                                    </html:tbody>
                                 </html:table>
                                 </html:td>
                           </html:tr>
                        </html:tbody>
                     </html:table>
                     </html:body></html:html>
